description_en: Restores data to a new AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb clone-db-instance --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --src-db-instance-name gp-bp000000000000000 --backup-id 1111111111 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloneDBInstance

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the new instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html接口查看目标地域下所有实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the source instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
克隆源实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: src_db_instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup set.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/210093.html operation to query the IDs of all backup sets of the instance. Only snapshot backup sets are supported
parameters.help_zh:
备份集ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/210093.html查看目标实例下所有备份集的备份集ID。仅支持快照备份集
parameters.name: backup_id

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request
